pages.text: Link for e-Jagriti portal is as follows.- https://e-jagriti.gov.in/ e-Jagriti portal for online filling Supporting documents and supporting videos have been provided to help consumers file complaints on the above portal. The link to the said documents and videos is given below. Documents – https://e-jagriti.gov.in/help-docs Videos – https://e-jagriti.gov.in/help-videos
